system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Pydantic Deep Agents auto-discovers and injects project-specific context into every conversation
system_prompt_style.note: MEMORY.md auto-injected into system prompt; AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/SOUL.md discovered at runtime.

env_context_strategy.note: Context files injected too, but those are project instructions rather than repo context.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Auto-summarization when approaching token budget (LLM-based or sliding window)
context_compaction.note: Eviction capability intercepts large tool outputs; sliding window = truncate_oldest.

observation_format.evidence_quote: Browser automation via Playwright — `navigate`, `click`, `type_text`, `screenshot`, `execute_js`, and more
observation_format.note: Screenshots only with the browser extra; text otherwise.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Works with any model that supports tool-calling

tool_count.note: Count of listed core tools; todo/subagent/web/fork tools add more when enabled.

edit_primitive.note: edit_file inferred as string edit; write_file is full-content write.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: The docstring becomes the tool's description, the type hints become its schema

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Split an in-flight `agent.run()` into N parallel branches with copy-on-write isolation, per-branch budgets, a test-runner hook, and four merge modes
loop_primitives.note: Default is react; forking/plan mode are opt-in flags.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: **Planning** — Task tracking with subtasks, dependencies, and cycle detection
planning_granularity.note: include_todo enabled by default per docs 'planning ... enabled by default'.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: include_subagents=True, # Multi-agent swarm — delegate to subagents
multi_agent_topology.note: Subagents/teams are explicit opt-in flags; orchestrator_workers and peer (message bus) reachable.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Spawn isolated subagents for parallel workstreams. Each subagent is a full deep agent

state_persistence.evidence_quote: **Checkpoints** — Save state, rewind or fork conversations. In-memory and file-based stores

self_verification.evidence_quote: Test-runner hook — run a shell command against each branch's snapshot; exit code feeds the judge

termination_condition.evidence_quote: Detects repeated identical tool calls, A-B-A-B alternating patterns, and no-op calls. Warns the model or stops the run.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Real-time token and USD cost tracking per run and cumulative. Hard budget limits with BudgetExceededError.
cost_controls.note: token_budget is explicit; caching/routing inferred from pydantic-ai and fallback chains — low certainty.
